description: Remote I/O of the Cnc886 control: Elsaco PROMOS line2 modules on CAN bus 2 (A1.X2 of the IPC). Addresses set on the modules: A2 = ADR 02, A3 = ADR 03, A5 = ADR 05. 24 V DC supply from U2 through fuses FU3 (servos / non-disconnecting outputs, T 4 A), FU4 (disconnecting outputs + pump I/O, T 3.15 A), FU5-FU8 (input circuits, X, Y, Z / hand wheel, T 1-2 A), FU9 (PLC supply, T 0.8 A). Potential (wire) numbers are given in column 'pot'. Sheets 29 (bus wiring), 31-33 (circuits), 52-54 (I/O tables).

modules.type: Elsaco CBIO-12 (EI 5852.22) - 8 DI 24 V DC + 8 DO relay NO/NC 8 A, CANopen

digital_inputs.function: State of emergency stop safety module (from FB1 XPS-AC5121 output)
Electric drives OK (BTR/RTO ready contacts of drives GF2.7 and GF1.1 in series)
Pressure of the air OK (pressure switch SP1)
Drilling machine normal position Z1 / tools interchanger cover open (option, not used)
Drilling machine working position Z1 / tools interchanger cover closed (option, not used)
Grease cup empty level (central lubrication A90, option 90)

digital_outputs.function: Controlling system disconnect (to pump I/O cable XT7 and E-stop circuit)
AXIS ENABLE - hardware enable of all servo drives (X3 ENABLE inputs)
WATER Z1 / tool cooling - cutting head ON/OFF valve YV11
Front protection shield up / front protection visor valve YV6
DC el. drive up Z1 / drilling machine move / workpiece pneumatic release (option)
DC el. drive down Z1 / workpiece pneumatic fixation (option)

modules.type: Elsaco CAIO-12 (EI 5842.00) - 12-slot analogue/binary carrier with plug-in modules, CANopen

channels.function: CENTRAL WATER JETS STOP button SB6 (and humidity sensor SQ18 chain)

plug_in_modules.module: -A3.DO8 EBO-10 (1 binary output 12-40 V DC 2 A)

channels.function: HEIGHT CONTROL SYSTEM Z1 - Festo SMAT-8E sensor SQ14 (option 65)
Z axis height control system MOVE1 - valve YV14 (option 65)

modules.free_slots: Slots 0-1, 3-7 and 11 of the CAIO-12 carrier are not populated in the standard configuration - candidates for added analogue/binary I/O (Elsaco EBI-12 inputs, EBO-10 outputs, EAII-12 analogue input modules).

modules.type: Elsaco CBIO-12 - 8 DI + 8 DO relay, CANopen (option 50 barrier safety module)

digital_inputs.function: State of light barriers safety module (FB2 XPS-AFL5130)

digital_outputs.function: Front protection shield DOWN / pneumatic door unlock

pump_io_interface.description: Relay-level handshake between the table control (PLC A2 + E-stop chain) and the JETS 3.8/60 pump PLC, cable -WS7 Olflex Classic 110 25G0.75 via terminal -XT7 (sheet 42, option 40). The RS485 pair (+RxTxD/-RxTxD, option 47) runs in the same cable to the SLC31 converter A43 on XCOM1 of the IPC (sheet 25).

signals.name: COM_IN3
signals.function: PRESS PUMP HIGH PRESSURE (switch to HI preset)

signals.name: COM_IN4
signals.function: PRESS PUMP LOW PRESSURE (switch to LO preset)

signals.name: COM_OUT5
signals.function: HIGH PRESSURE PUMP ADJUSTMENT MODE (servicing mode / safety key locked)

signals.name: E-stop loop
signals.function: Pump total-stop contact in the XPS-AC5121 chain (XT7/6, pot 109/119)

pump_io_interface.pump_side_terminals: XT7 pins 2-8 -> pump control distributor terminals TB1-TB5 / X4-X6 (pump manual 2.4, scheme PTV-011-D-0192 pages 4-10)

spare_capacity_for_additions: PLC A2: all 8 DI and 8 DO are assigned; DI 1.5/1.6 and DO 1.3/1.5/1.6 serve options that are not installed on this machine (drilling machine, second head, DC Z drive) and are physically free at the terminal board A2.X (check Cnc886 PLC configuration before reuse).
PLC A3 carrier: free module slots (see above).
Another CBIO-12/CAIO-12 module can be added on CAN 2 (new node address, termination at the last node - the bus currently ends at the abrasive feeder IFA61 'SET 5' on sheet 50).
Drive digital outputs DOUT1/DOUT2 (X3) of each SERVOSTAR are wired to the X3 connector but not used in the standard schematic (sheet 28).
